 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Cooper Flagg and the Dallas Mavericks host Draymond Green and the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 Both teams enter the matchup on three-game losing streaks. Head coach Steve Kerr and his Warriors lost to Zion Williamson and the New Orleans Pelicans, 115-94, on Monday. Dallas enters the game with a .500 record at 7-7, most recently losing to the Boston Celtics, 131-94, on Sunday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Warriors vs Mavericks TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 Venue: American Airlines Center, Dallas
 TV: DirecTV, NBA League Pass, KFAA-TV, MavsTV
 Live stream: NBA League Pass through Amazon Prime Video, Fubo, YouTube TV
 Fans can watch for free most readily through the Fubo app. Fans can watch the game for free through various avenues. One option is Amazon Prime, where users can sign up for a seven-day free trial of NBA League Pass.
 Another option for fans to watch for free is with DraftKings Sportsbook, which offers a three-month free trial. Users must submit a minimum deposit of $5. Fans can also watch for free through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free-trial subscription that can be canceled before five days.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For Golden State, forward Draymond Green (elbow) and center Al Horford (back) are both game-time decisions, while guard Brandon Williams (hamstring) and star guard Stephen Curry (abdomen) are out for the game.
 For Dallas, forward Tobi Lawal (groin) and guard Walter Clayton Jr. (ankle) are both game-time decisions for the matchup, while forward Sergio De Larrea (knee), center Dereck Lively II (foot) and forward Tarik Biberovic (heel) are all out for the game.
